description: Explain a standard 5-field cron expression in plain English and list its next N run times (default 5, max 20) in any IANA zone, DST-correct. Supports lists, ranges, steps (*/n, a-b/n), month/weekday names, 0 or 7 = Sunday and @yearly/@monthly/@weekly/@daily/@hourly/@reboot; applies cron's day-of-month OR day-of-week rule and notes it. Rejects invalid and never-firing expressions with a precise reason. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/cron-explain

expr.description: 5-field cron expression or macro, e.g. "*/15 9-17 * * mon-fri" or "@daily". Alias: cron

from.description: Start after this time (ISO 8601 / epoch; default now)

tz.description: IANA zone for the run times (default UTC)

name: cron_explain
title: Cron Explain
